comment.grade_splus: Exceptional performance with plenty of headroom in every area.
comment.grade_s: Excellent performance. Heavy 3D and multi-core work run smoothly.
comment.grade_a: Solid performance with consistent frame times.
comment.grade_b: Good everyday performance. Heavy 3D scenes may limit frame rates.
comment.grade_c: Basic performance. Close other apps and plug in the dock for best results.
comment.gpu_bound: Graphics is the limiting part in demanding scenes.
comment.cpu_bound: The processor limits performance before graphics does.
comment.balanced: Processor and graphics are well balanced.
comment.scaling_good: Multi-core scaling is excellent: {0}x across {1} threads.
comment.scaling_low: Multi-core scaling is modest: {0}x across {1} threads. Close background apps.
comment.io_fast: Storage is fast; saving and loading should feel instant.
comment.io_slow: Storage is slow; large files may take a while to load.
comment.pacing_smooth: Frame pacing is smooth with very few dips.
comment.pacing_var: Frame times dipped at times. Check cooling and background apps.

stage.1.desc: One processor core on integer, floating-point, hashing and sorting work.
stage.2.desc: All processor cores together, rendering a ray-traced scene live.
stage.3.desc: Read, write and copy speed of the main memory, plus its access delay.
stage.4.desc: Sequential and random file speed, plus saving and loading data.
stage.5.desc: Fill rate with many layers and thousands of moving particles.
stage.6.desc: A detailed 3D scene drawn at full speed. Measures frame rate and smoothness.
stage.7.desc: A detailed 3D scene drawn at full speed. Measures frame rate and smoothness.
